answer_4.quote: the scores assigned by the FEI raters in the double rating procedure are also available. They have a QWK of 0.71 (correlation of 0.93) with each other and 0.84 (correlation of 0.85) with the CEFR-level of the essay.
answer_4.guideline: raters use adapted CEFR descriptors and scales. The descriptors (and the rating) are holistic, although each descriptor is aiming at linguistic (organisational), pragmatic and sociolinguistic dimensions and their related criteria.
